References / Poster / 525

Plusea, PIFpack riso poster

An instruction poster for a wearable tool bag, riso-printed in fluorescent pink and a dark blue-gray, with technical drawings and dot-matrix lettering.

Source
Flickr: Plusea, “PIFpack RISO printed posters”

Rights
Open license, stored. License: CC-BY-2.0. Rights policy

Context

The Flickr title is “PIFpack RISO printed posters”, posted under CC BY 2.0 by Plusea. The poster’s footer reads “www.wsp.plusea.at”, the uploader’s own Wearable Studio Practice site, which supports that the uploader made it.

Observed

  • Two inks: fluorescent pink for the tools and labels, and a dark blue-gray for drawings, dimensions, and text.
  • The blue-gray bands that mark the bag’s seams are screened and grainy.
  • Pink squares hold dot-and-line monograms, and the title “PIFPACK” is drawn from dots and lines.
  • Text is a clean sans-serif and stays sharp.

Why it belongs

The poster shows that riso suits diagrams as well as art: the fluorescent ink highlights, the dark ink explains.

Borrow

Use fluorescent pink only for the objects to notice, and a dark spot ink for all structure and text.
